purpose: Teach: お洒落/そんなふうに/もらえれ/言えよ/これだけ/その頃/スポンジ/ゼリー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、今日、お前の髪、お洒落だね、新しい?
lines.en: Hey Riku, your hair looks really good today — did you get it cut?
lines.style: Light, teasing confidence. Quick, warm opening. The easiness of a friendship that can notice without it becoming a thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。そんなふうに褒められると、照れるな、桜。
lines.en: Yeah. When you say stuff like that I get all self-conscious, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft laugh tucked under the words. A little bashful, but genuine — not performing shyness. Quieter on the name, like he's checking that it's really her noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放課後、時間、もらえれば、勉強教えてほしいの。
lines.en: After school — if you have time — could you help me study?
lines.style: The brightness drops. Careful setup, like she's asking for something bigger than tutoring. Steady delivery, slightly held-back, afraid of sounding needy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 告白、勇気出して、言えよ、後悔しないように。
lines.en: Come on. You've got to tell him. Don't end up regretting it.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A gentle push, not a lecture. The voice of someone who sees her struggling and cares enough to nudge her toward courage.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: これだけ頑張ってる私、見てて欲しいだけなの。
lines.en: I just want him to notice how hard I'm working. That's all.
lines.style: Smaller voice. The admission underneath the words. Trailing off slightly — not quite a question, not quite a statement. Vulnerable in the way she didn't mean to be.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: その頃、俺たち、隣のクラスだったよな、覚えてる?
lines.en: Remember back when we were in the class next door? That was us.
lines.style: Nostalgic half-smile in the voice. Gentle, drifting — like he's remembering something he didn't realize he was keeping. Slower pace. A question that isn't really a question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: コンビニのスポンジケーキ、結構、美味しいよ、最近の。
lines.en: You know, the sponge cake from the convenience store actually tastes pretty good these days.
lines.style: A shift back — brighter, lighter. Redirect energy. He's changing the subject and both of them know it. Quick, animated, almost too casual.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夏祭りのゼリー、毎年、楽しみだな。
lines.en: The jelly at the summer festival every year — that's always something to look forward to.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Slowing down again, gentle close. Not quite resolution, but a moment of quiet relief. Like he's remembering what matters doesn't always need to be said.
